name: Reply in Channel
description: Discord-style Reply in Channel - reply to any message inline with a blockquote of the original

options.display_name: Install default (fresh install: block; upgraded install: allow)
Always block replies to /ric echo posts
Never block replies to /ric echo posts

settings.help_text: The echo-thread guard rejects the first reply typed into the thread of a /ric channel post (with a link to the original thread) and refuses /ric inside such threads. Install default: fresh installs block, while installs upgraded from a version without this feature keep their previous non-blocking behavior. The two explicit choices override that and survive all future upgrades. Either way, echo threads that already have replies are never sealed.
